name: music-toggle-button

frames.best_why: The five bars are at staggered full heights, clearly showing the playing equaliser state.

tagline: Tiny waveform bars bounce inside a round play button.
summary: A compact play and pause button with five thin waveform bars that spring to random heights while playing and settle flat when paused. The pill swells on hover and press.
appearance: A black circular button holding five thin vertical white bars, sitting inside a dark rounded card beside an album thumbnail, track title, artist name and a thin progress line. The bars read like a tiny equaliser.
behaviour: Clicking toggles playback: the bars spring to staggered heights on a fast loop while the button pads outward, then collapse to even stubs when paused. Hovering and pressing swell the pill.
demo_content: Track Night Drive by Kaia Moreno, album Lowlight, with the prompt Click to play.
use_when: A music card or header needs a small play or pause control that signals sound with moving bars.
avoid_when: The bars are tiny and the button has no visible text, so its purpose depends on surrounding track details.
customise: Only the audio source, starting playing state and class name are props. Bar count, animation timing and the wrapper styling are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A tiny five-bar animation on a single button; idle when paused.

a11y.note: It is a div with role button and aria-pressed but no tabIndex or key handler, so it cannot be focused or activated from the keyboard.

issues: The control is a plain div, so it cannot be tabbed to or activated with Enter or Space.
polish_why: Clean card and a playful equaliser, though the tiny bars carry all the character.
